verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud's official MCP server lets an AI agent create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics "all from the conversation". It has a documented connect command and user-controlled permissions, so the product can be operated in natural language. Built-in Natural Language Search covers NL querying of the data itself. Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on corroboration of NL operation, evidence that NL operation covers self-hosted (non-Cloud) deployments, and a native NL interface that works without bringing an external AI agent.
